title: Define DataProvider abstract base class
objective: A concrete ABC exists that all data providers must implement, with clear method signatures matching the architectural spec

methods.name: get_bars
methods.signature: (self, symbols: list[str], start: datetime, end: datetime, timeframe: Timeframe) -> pd.DataFrame
methods.returns: Wide-format DataFrame with UTC DatetimeIndex, columns named {SYM}_{field}

methods.name: available_fields
methods.returns: List of field name strings this provider offers

acceptance_criteria: DataProvider cannot be instantiated directly (raises TypeError)
A subclass that implements all three methods can be instantiated
A subclass missing any method raises TypeError on instantiation
get_bars return type annotation is pd.DataFrame
stream_bars return type annotation is Iterator[BarEvent]
available_fields return type annotation is list[str]
